relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: localized injections of the side-directed TRPV1 agonist capsaicin and resiniferatoxin are undergoing clinical trials in patients with osteoarthritis and bone cancer pain

key_findings: Review: TRP channels (TRPV1, TRPA1, TRPM3, TRPC5) remain promising pain targets; high-dose capsaicin patches are in clinical use and TRPV1 agonist injections are in trials.
